title: Compute brief — 10 September 2026
description: PUCT Project 58481 permanent ≥75 MW rule votes tomorrow; IREN Sweetwater 2 GW lands Base Load in Batch Zero. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 56 confirms, 0 ticks.
lede: The conversion clock is still Texas process, now with a named campus print. Tomorrow’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) takes up Project 58481 — the permanent ≥75 MW large-load interconnection rule — with staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cutting post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20% while keeping the $50k/MW security, and three 765 kV transmission items on the same agenda. Separately, IREN’s 8 Sep GlobeNewswire release put the 2 GW Sweetwater Hub (1,400 MW + 600 MW) into ERCOT Batch Zero as conditional Base Load — the first major named campus disclosure after ERCOT’s 3 Sep classifications notice. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 56 re-read list prints; CoreWeave spot rows not visible in today’s static HTML.
